preconditions.description: The number of rounds played is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(name.islower() and 1 <= len(name) <= 32 for name in names)
preconditions.description: Each player's name is a string of lowercase Latin letters with a length between 1 and 32.

preconditions.expression: all(-1000 <= score <= 1000 for score in scores)
preconditions.description: Each score is an integer between -1000 and 1000.

postconditions.description: The output is the name of one of the players.
The maximum number of points is determined.

postconditions.expression: winners = [name for name, score in points.items() if score == max_points]
postconditions.description: The list of winners is determined based on the maximum number of points.
The output is the name of the player who scored at least the maximum number of points first.
